benchmark_entry.name: Formalize the FRA value δ·P(0,T₂)·(F−K) and simple forward rate F = (P(0,T₁)/P(0,T₂)−1)/δ
benchmark_entry.description: Simple forward rate, FRA value, and fair-rate identity

code.lean:
import MathFin.FixedIncome.SimpleForwardRate

open MathFin

/-- Simple forward rate, FRA value, and fair-rate identity -/
theorem mf_forward_rate_simple (r t T₁ T₂ : ℝ) (hδ : T₂ - T₁ ≠ 0) (K : ℝ) : let δ :=
  MathFin.fra_value r t T₁ T₂ hδ K
